mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID prodId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, NVL(RPI2.PROD_RE,RPI.PROD_RE) regCode, RPI.SET_DATE setDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT PINDEX.UNIT_VALUE_T lastUnitValueT FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN DPB ON DPB.PROD_ID=INFO.PROD_ID AND DPB.DATA_STATUS='E' INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON PINDEX.PROD_ID=INFO.PROD_ID AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' AND PINDEX.VALUE_DATE=DPB.SETT_DATE WHERE DPB.DATA_STATUS = 'E' AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DPB.SETT_DATE = ( select max(h.SETT_DATE) from DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN h where h.SETT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and h.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and h.DATA_STATUS = 'E' )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')||'至'||TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') nextRange,TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') nextMdate FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO,DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP WHERE INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPEN_END_DATE>TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY DPP.OPEN_END_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT PINDEX.ASSETS_VALUE /**资产净值**/ ,PINDEX.CAPITAL /**期末余额**/ ,PLAN.SETT_DATE /*基准日*/ ,PLAN.PAYMENT_DATE /*红利发放日*/ ,DPP.OPEN_START_DATE /*开放起始日*/ ,DPP.OPEN_END_DATE /*开放结束日*/ ,TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') curBaseDate ,TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')||'至'||TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') curRange FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPEN_END_DATE <=TO_DATE(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON PINDEX.PROD_ID=INFO.PROD_ID AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' AND PINDEX.VALUE_DATE=DPP.OPEN_END_DATE LEFT JOIN DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN PLAN ON PLAN.PROD_ID=INFO.PROD_ID AND PLAN.DATA_STATUS='E' AND PLAN.SETT_DATE=DPP.OPEN_END_DATE WHERE INFO.STATUS='E' AND INFO.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
